Las frases sobre la noticia (quién la informó, que es tendencia) no cuentan.": "An LLM reads all the pages and lists the verifiable data points (figures, testimonies, places), marking which pages each one appears on. Two wordings of the same data point count as a single fact: paraphrasing doesn't fool it.
